method: Whole-file manual reading of four MessageBoxDlg/AboutDlg files; pinned bytes verified. No Windows runtime execution.
findings: Message dialog stores copies of message, title, optional list and checkbox state. List is sorted and owner-data rendering checks index, subitem, text mask and destination capacity before bounded copy. List selection changes are vetoed.

Checkbox state is read in explicit left/middle/right click handlers before CloseModal. This class does not persist suppression decisions itself; caller use and other close routes must be reviewed separately.

Constructor handles six MB_TYPEMASK variants using a map with assert plus at(); unsupported variants can throw. Retry/abort/ignore labels are intentionally blank placeholders. No runtime caller violation demonstrated.

Custom dialog chooses initial focus from button-type table; MB_DEFBUTTON flags are not interpreted here. Global wrappers use native message boxes in light mode and custom dialog in dark mode, so complete flag parity is not established.
Text measurement expands width/height, auto-width uses unwrapped measurement and removes resizing border. No explicit monitor-size cap appears here; huge/localized messages require UI qualification.

About dialog creates read-only RichEdit pages from built-in/localized strings and license resource. Detected link clicks delegate to ShellExecute; this review did not activate links or send external messages.
About keyboard handling cycles tabs and OK focus, Escape posts OK, and mouse filtering suppresses text selection. Actual accessibility and keyboard behavior require Windows execution.
limits: No native message-box parity, close-route checkbox behavior, oversized-message, keyboard, accessibility or localization GUI tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains 147/500.
